question_text: Describe how you identify a target audience.
expected_answer: You analyze customer needs review demographics and match the product to the right group

question_text: Explain how you position a product against competitors.
expected_answer: You highlight strengths identify unique value and show why it fits customer needs

question_text: Describe how you create a simple marketing message.
expected_answer: You focus on clarity emphasize benefits and keep the message concise

question_text: Explain how you evaluate customer feedback for marketing use.
expected_answer: You review comments identify patterns and adjust messaging accordingly

question_text: Describe how you promote a product through multiple channels.
expected_answer: You use social email and in store communication to reach customers

question_text: Explain how you identify what motivates a customer to buy.
expected_answer: You ask questions observe behavior and match motivations to product benefits

question_text: Describe how you build interest in a product.
expected_answer: You highlight unique features share success stories and create curiosity

question_text: Explain how you adjust messaging for different customer types.
expected_answer: You tailor tone focus on relevant benefits and match the message to the audience

question_text: Describe how you evaluate the success of a promotion.
expected_answer: You measure engagement review sales impact and compare results to goals

question_text: Explain how you create a simple value proposition.
expected_answer: You state the problem show the solution and highlight the benefit clearly
